name: Palantir Technologies Inc.
summary: Palantir Technologies Inc. engineers and provides advanced software solutions primarily for the intelligence sector, aiding in counterterrorism investigations and operational responses across the United States, United Kingdom, and internationally. Its key offerings include: Palantir Gotham: This platform is designed to unearth intricate patterns concealed within diverse datasets, ranging from signals intelligence to confidential reports. It facilitates a seamless transition of insights from analysts to field operators, empowering them to strategize and execute real-world interventions against identified threats. Palantir Foundry: Revolutionizing organizational data management, Foundry acts as a central operating system, enabling users to effortlessly integrate and analyze disparate data sources in one comprehensive environment. Palantir Apollo: This software ensures efficient delivery of applications and updates throughout an enterprise, allowing for flexible deployment in virtually any computing environment. Palantir Artificial Intelligence Platform: Offering consolidated access to open-source, self-hosted, and commercial large language models (LLMs), this platform converts both structured and unstructured data into LLM-interpretable objects, transforming organizational processes into actionable tools for human users and AI agents alike. In a strategic collaboration with Stagwell Inc., Palantir is also developing an AI-driven marketing platform. This initiative aims to harness the combined power of data and artificial intelligence to significantly enhance marketing return on investment. The company was founded in 2003 and its headquarters are located in Denver, Colorado.
